scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:package && bun run build:site
scripts.dev: bun run build:package && cd worker && bunx wrangler dev
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && (cd packages/instantmap && bun test) && (cd worker && bun test)
scripts.typecheck: (cd packages/instantmap && bunx tsc --noEmit) && (cd worker && bunx tsc --noEmit)
scripts.lint: oxlint packages/instantmap/src worker/src scripts site/src && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run size
